additional_info.body:
The customer needs the connection data to activate the charging station in their own network via Ethernet (grant access to the Internet).
The following information is required from the customer:
1. Which port is the station connected to
2. Local IP address of the charging station

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0392089-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2 / S6 313709755001] Technical Query CRM:01811000488
additional_info.body:
Hello Gyoergy,
Hope you are doing well.
Here is the infromation that you needed from our end :
To set up your device correctly, always connect the Ethernet cable to the WAN port.
This will establish the internet connection.
Once the cable is properly connected, the device will automatically establish the internet connection. After this, an IP address will be generated automatically.
I hope this resolves your query. Kindly confirm if everything is working as expected so we can proceed with case closure.
If you need any further assistance or have any other questions, feel free to reach out.
Best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
